title: How can a fee list explain ranges without confusing patients
body:
Try the fictional fee list and compare its exact, from, range and quote-required entries. Which labels or mobile layouts need improvement? Please use invented service names and values, and never share patient information. [Dentist Web Design](https://dentistwebdesign.uk/) maintains the formatter. This thread is for presentation and publishing workflow, not treatment or clinical pricing advice.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/Dentist-Web-Design/dental-fee-table#readme), then run the documented example locally.
